title: Decoupled scope-buckets and staff-fractionation framework for cycle flexibility
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: As we scale Redwood's product teams and support more concurrent initiatives (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private), traditional fixed-scope cycle commitments are causing brittle handoffs and repeated mid-cycle scrambles. Objective: Define a pragmatic framework that decouples scope into stable 'platform' buckets and flexible 'opportunity' buckets, and pairs those with a staff-fractionation model (rotating micro-allocations) so we can preserve predictability for critical work while rapidly absorbing emergent priorities.

Scope: This ticket produces a playbook and decision matrix for (1) how to categorize work into scope-buckets, (2) how to allocate rotating staff fractions (e.g., 10-30%) across teams, (3) guardrails for mid-cycle scope cuts, and (4) tooling suggestions for tracking allocations in the cycle board. Deliverables: one-page playbook, decision matrix CSV, sample cycle staffing plan for next two cycles, template JIRA/Linear tracker columns, and a short rollout guide for ENG/PD/DX leads.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Playbook doc finalized and reviewed by eng/product/design leads; 2) Decision matrix with clear bucketing rules and examples for common Redwood work types (runtime perf, console UX, Dedicated contracts); 3) Two sample cycle plans demonstrating staff fractionation applied to at least 3 cross-functional initiatives; 4) A Linear cycle board template created and validated in dry-run with one pod; 5) Leadership sign-off on guardrail thresholds (min platform headcount, max fraction variability).
updates: 2026-03-02: Initial draft of bucketing taxonomy completed. Included buckets: Platform-Stable, Platform-HighRisk, Customer-Commit, Opportunity-Experiment. Shared with ENG leads for feedback.
2026-03-04: Feedback from ML infra: recommend explicit bucket for 'Inference SLAs' to prevent platform slippage under Dedicated workloads. Added example mapping to decision matrix.
2026-03-05: Aligned with Design on definition of 'Opportunity' scope to avoid UX debt (Design requires 30% of opportunity work to include prototype + usability check).
2026-03-06: Draft playbook sent to PM leadership for review (Confluence link below). Planning dry-run with Search & Latency pod in Cycle 2026-W12.
Risks: If fractionation is mis-applied, platform SLOs could regress. Mitigations include hard thresholds and a mandatory quarterly 'platform health' gate before any fraction increases.
